flawless: I founded a nation on ground harder than you. Rest easy; few would have done better.
Seven clans, seven blades, and not one of them was ever tested.
Benalia was built by hands like mine. You couldn't so much as shake them.
solid: You struck the founder of Benalia and lived to tell it. That is no small thing.
My knees ache, and my children's children would laugh. Still, the day is mine.
close: By the first stone of Benalia, you almost toppled me!
I waited ages to see this land once more, and you nearly sent me back into the past.
